name: Macaron
message: 「Awh... Somehow, I ended up somewhere weird...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh? What, Big Sis Helena's room...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, I-I knew that! It's not like I got lost or anything」

name: Macaron
message: 「So, what's up? Trophies?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Whoa, amazing! You got all of them!」

name: Macaron
message: 「This calls for a celebration, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then we've gotta celebrate with a huge ba-ba-bang!」

name: Helena
message: 「At times like this, leave it to this tipsy lady!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Whaat!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Tamiko-chan, Melilot, capture Macaron-chan!」

name: Riesling
message: 「At your service」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh!? W-Wait, what's the big idea!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ufufu... It just wouldn't be fair if I were the only one put through something embarrassing, now would it...」

name: Macaron
message: 「What kind of grip strength is this!?」

name: Helena
message: 「You see, just once, I've been dying to see what Macaron-chan looks like without her coat on」

name: Macaron
message: 「Eh, ah, yeah... If that's all, I don't really mind...」

name: Helena
message: 「And then, if I'm lucky, I wanted to see what you look like without all the stuff underneath it taken off too...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh, whaaat!? Hold on, wait a second!」

name: Helena
message: 「Aaaah... My heart's starting to pound!」

name: Helena
message: 「Normally I only ever undress bouncy, big-breasted girls, so having a more modest girl like you in front of me...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I said, what's the big idea!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「My apologies, Macaron-san...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now that things have come to this, it is impossible to stop an awakened Helena」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah, what an unfortunate accident this is, boo-hoo-hoo...」

name: Riesling
message: 「At your service」

name: Macaron
message: 「H-Hey, no way!」

name: Macaron
message: 「W-Wait, that's right! Hey! Wh-What happened to the celebration!?」

name: Helena
message: 「How the hell should I know?!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Myaaaaah!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Guhehehe...」

name: Helena
message: 「My trophy collecting ends here, but your body still has a future ahead of it, Macaron!」

name: Helena
message: 「Because from now on, I'm going to thoroughly and intimately break you in\s07」

name: Macaron
message: 「N-no, ah...」

name: Macaron
message: 「S-stooooop it!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「In any case, congratulations on completing the mission」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please do come visit Helena's room again in the future」

name: Macaron
message: 「I reaaally don't wanna!!」
